about_the_game:
Welcome to Fortune, a world overshadowed by colossal trees that blanket the entire world. A case has disrupted the peace here. You will play the role of a detective, delving through the veils of mystery surrounding the case to unearth the truth. Can you successfully solve the mystery in the end? It's depends on your choices.

The planet was a place humans once set foot on hundreds of years ago. After their departure, mutated giant trees split it into two separate worlds – the Upper Realm and the Bottom Realm. These two worlds have developed vastly different cultures almost independently. Diplomatic ties were only gradually forged several decades ago. As a detective from the Bottom, you'll journey back and forth between the two worlds, experiencing the clash of diverse cultures.

This is an RPG game. In the game, you would search for objects and characters, for your pivotal actions, you can opt for different plot progressions. Each choice leads to an independent story-line, and simultaneously, it significantly impacts the case investigation, thereby influencing the final outcome. It has multiple endings, and any of the main characters you meet in the game could potentially turn out to be crucial to the case.
